subject: MAP seed: rapid-iterate acceptance spine (doc + slides)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@averysolutions.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP seed: rapid-iterate acceptance spine (doc + slides)

Hi team — sharing a compact starter for the MAP and a paired slide skeleton so we can move faster on Avery’s 30->60 acceptance run. My aim is a tight, reviewable draft with clear owners for each acceptance gate (tech, security, procurement, exec sign-off).

Link to editable files (internal share + customer view):
- Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgMapSeedStub
- Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/2SlIdE-AcceptanceSpine

What I pushed into the doc:
- 30-day compact milestones (Week 1: infra & test harness, Week 2: integration + eval, Week 3: KPI validation, Week 4: acceptance run)
- Acceptance criteria per milestone (pass/fail conditions, minimal telemetry to capture)
- Owner column (sales/CS/eng/legal) + suggested owner names — please replace with final owners
- Procurement & legal checklist row (PO, contract SLA expectations, data residency note)

Asks:
1) Marissa — can you add the customer success checkpoint and fleshed-out validation prompts (we want deterministic eval prompts for the acceptance run)?
2) Jonas — quick review of the infra milestones and whether the sequence looks realistic given the Dedicated ramp we scoped yesterday. If short, say what to cut.
3) Neha — add a line for security evidence we should collect during Week 2 (SOC2 logs, access matrix snapshot).
4) I’ll loop Avery to confirm timeline and constraints after your updates; we should aim to send them a clean MAP tomorrow EOD.

Attachments: MAP-seed-starter (Google Doc), Acceptance-spine (Google Slides)

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Lead, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@averysolutions.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP seed: rapid-iterate acceptance spine (doc + slides)

Thanks Tessa — looks like a solid start. I made inline edits in the Doc (highlighted comments where I want Avery to confirm business KPIs). Key additions:
- Week 2 validation prompts (simple QA list + 6 deterministic prompts we can run against the model)
- Stakeholder RACI: added "Beth (Avery) — business sign-off" and "Rahul (Infra) — on-call for Week 2"

Two asks from procurement/legal I want to surface before we send:
- Procurement asked that we include estimated monthly unit cost ranges for the pilot cadence (not a final quote, but a ballpark). I added a placeholder — Evan (sales ops) can fill in numbers.
- Legal wants a short note on data retention and logs visibility during the pilot. Neha, can you propose the minimal set of artifacts we’ll commit to share?

I also attached a simple test-case CSV in the doc comments (refer to the "Sample prompts" section) — not attaching binary here, left as doc table. If nobody objects, I’ll tidy the slides to mirror the Doc milestones.

—Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Quick read-through — sequence looks fine. A couple notes:
- Move "integration smoke" to Day 3 of Week 2 so we have 48 hours for any model conversion/fine-tune staging.
- If they want Dedicated at pilot scale, we should flag potential lead time for capacity (I added a comment in the doc).

I’ll be available for the customer sync Thur 10–11am if you want me on the call.

Jonas

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP seed: rapid-iterate acceptance spine (doc + slides)

Thanks for the share — this is exactly what we needed to see. A few notes from our side:
- The 30->60 cadence looks aggressive but doable if we keep scope minimal on Week 3 KPI validation. We can prioritize two primary user journeys rather than three.
- Procurement: Mike will need the rough monthly cost estimate before next Wed to route the PO.
- Security: we can provide a SOC2 snapshot and a short access matrix; will confirm the person who ships those (likely me + Mike).

We’re fine with the mock prompts Marissa added — the team will run them and push results into the Doc comments. Confirming Thur 10:15am PT for the sync (Jonas on the call is great).

Sara

--

Product Director
Avery Solutions
